title: Clean Sweep
style: A fussy, elegant harpsichord minuet for Fuzzle's cleaning, crashed by chaotic drums and slide whistles for Milo's mess; the two themes eventually play together as a duet.
rules: Original instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no spoken word.

hit_points.cue: Spooky drone that breaks into a dainty harpsichord trill on the duster flick.
The minuet is smashed by a chaotic drum fill.
Minuet and drum crashes alternate faster and faster.
Music stops on the brick crunch.
Silence with only a ticking clock.
Toy piano plays the minuet sweetly.
Minuet and the mess drums play together as a duet.
The minuet on celesta with a final playful drum tap, landing on G major at the cut.

end_card.cue: Music resolves on the final chord exactly at the cut; ODDLY sting plays over 2.0s end card.
